Section 256.165, subsection 1, paragraph b, 4 Code 2026, is amended to read as follows: 5 b. (1) The board shall issue a transitional coaching 6 authorization to an individual applicant who is at least 7 twenty-one years of age and who provides verification of an 8 offer of a coaching position by a school or a consortium of 9 schools, but who has not completed the coursework required 10 for a coaching authorization as specified in paragraph “a” . 11 A transitional coaching authorization is valid for not more 12 than one year, shall not be renewed, and is valid only in 13 the school or consortium of schools making the offer of the 14 coaching position. A consortium of schools may include a 15 school district, a school district school attendance center, 16 or an accredited nonpublic school, or any combination thereof. 17 However, prior to issuing a transitional coaching authorization 18 to an individual under this paragraph “b” , the board shall 19 ensure that the individual meets satisfies all of the following 20 requirements: 21 (1) Completes a shortened course of training relating to the 22 code of professional rights and responsibilities, practices, 23 and ethics developed in accordance with section 256.146, 24 subsection 1 , paragraph “a” , by the board specifically for 25 transitional coaches. 26 (2) (a) Completes The applicant successfully completes the 27 child and dependent adult abuse mandatory reporter training 28 required by sections section 232.69 and 235B.16 . 29 (3) (b) Completes The applicant successfully completes 30 a nationally recognized concussion in youth sports training 31 course. 32 (4) (c) Complies The applicant complies with the background 33 investigation requirements established by the board pursuant to 34 section 256.146, subsection 16 . 35 -1- HF 2686.3330 (1) 91 jda/jh 1/ 2 #1. (d) The applicant successfully completes training related 1 to cardiopulmonary resuscitation. 2 (e) The applicant successfully completes training related 3 to how use an automated external defibrillator. 4 (2) (a) A transitional coaching authorization shall expire 5 one year after the date of issuance. 6 (b) A transitional coaching authorization shall not be 7 renewed. 8 (3) The board shall allow an individual who holds a 9 transitional coaching authorization to convert the transitional 10 coaching authorization to a coaching authorization if the 11 individual does any of the following: 12 (a) Successfully completes the requirements established in 13 paragraph “a” . 14 (b) Successfully completes the fundamentals of coaching 15 course created by the national federation of state high school 16 associations. 17 Sec. 2.
